newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,113 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,113 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 1,113 contracts compared with 1,086 overnight Monday, according to the CBOT.
There were 92 wheat, 583 corn, 348 soybean, nine soymeal, 59 soyoil, one corn put and 21 soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/2 to two cents higher, corn was fractionally lower and soybeans were 2-1/2 to 3-3/4 cents lower.
